title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
qcoOrder: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
enforcingMinistry: Ministry of Steel, Govt. of India
scope: Covers requirements of high strength deformed steel bars (TMT bars) and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 500S, Fe 550, Fe 550D, Fe 600.
testingRequirements: 0.2 percent proof stress / yield stress determination
Tensile strength test and TS/YS ratio calculation
Elongation at fracture percentage
Bend and Rebend test
Chemical composition test (Carbon, Sulphur, Phosphorus, Carbon Equivalent)
Mass per metre run tolerance check

clauses.title: Chemical Composition
clauses.text: Maximum limits: Carbon 0.30% max for Fe 415, Sulphur 0.060% max, Phosphorus 0.060% max, S+P 0.110% max.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties
clauses.text: For Fe 500D: Minimum Yield Stress 500 N/mm², Minimum Tensile Strength 565 N/mm², Minimum Elongation 16.0%.

clauses.title: Rebend Test
clauses.text: Mandatory 135 degree bend around mandrel followed by aging in 100°C boiling water for 30 minutes and unbending to 157.5 degrees without fracture.

scheme: Scheme I - Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark)

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
qcoOrder: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations & FSSAI/BIS Joint Mandate
enforcingMinistry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
scope: Specifies physical, chemical, microbiological, toxic element, pesticide residue, and radio-isotope requirements for packaged drinking water sold in sealed bottles or containers.
testingRequirements: Microbiological testing (Escherichia coli, Coliforms, Salmonella, Pseudomonas aeruginosa)
Pesticide residue testing (Individual pesticides max 0.0001 mg/L, Total pesticides max 0.0005 mg/L)
Toxic metals analysis (Lead, Arsenic, Cadmium, Mercury, Chromium)
Organoleptic parameters (pH 6.5-8.5, TDS max 500 mg/L, Turbidity max 2 NTU)
Shelf-life stability test

clauses.title: Hygiene and Processing
clauses.text: Water shall be derived from suitable sources and subjected to treatment processes like decantation, filtration, aeration, ozonation, UV treatment, and reverse osmosis.

clauses.title: Pesticide Residues
clauses.text: Pesticide residues shall be tested as per IS 14543 Annex D and Annex E using Gas Chromatography (GC-MS) or LC-MS/MS.

clauses.title: Packaging
clauses.text: Shall be packed in food grade containers conforming to IS 15410 or IS 10146 with tamper-evident seals bearing the ISI Mark.

scheme: Scheme I - Mandatory ISI Certification Scheme

title: Drinking Water - Specification
qcoOrder: Recommended guideline for public piped water supplies; mandatory when specified in municipal contracts.
scope: Prescribes requirements, essential parameters, and desirable limits for drinking water supplied through municipal networks or decentralized sources across India.
testingRequirements: pH value (6.5 to 8.5)
Total Dissolved Solids (TDS: Acceptable limit 500 mg/l, Permissible limit 2000 mg/l)
Total Hardness as CaCO3 (Acceptable limit 200 mg/l, Permissible 600 mg/l)
Fluoride content (Acceptable limit 1.0 mg/l, Permissible limit 1.5 mg/l)
Bacteriological testing (E. coli nil in 100 ml)

clauses.title: Organoleptic and Physical Parameters
clauses.text: Color max 5 Hazen units, Odor agreeable, Turbidity max 1 NTU (permissible 5 NTU).

clauses.title: General Parameters Concerning Substances Undesirable in Excessive Amounts
clauses.text: Nitrate max 45 mg/l, Sulphate max 200 mg/l (permissible 400 mg/l), Iron max 1.0 mg/l.

title: General Requirements for Establishment and Operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres
qcoOrder: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020 (Amended 2021 & 2023)
enforcingMinistry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
scope: Specifies general requirements for competence, quality management systems, equipment, and XRF/Fire Assaying testing procedures for BIS Hallmarking Centres.
testingRequirements: X-ray Fluorescence (XRF) non-destructive screening
Fire Assay (Cupellation) destructive gold purity determination as per IS 1417
Laser marking of HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification) 6-digit alphanumeric code

clauses.title: Sampling and Reception
clauses.text: Jewellery received from registered jewelers must undergo strict log entry, weight verification to 0.01g precision, and non-destructive preliminary XRF testing.

clauses.title: Fire Assaying Procedure
clauses.text: Assaying shall follow cupellation technique in muffle furnace at 1100°C to achieve purity measurement accuracy down to parts per thousand (ppt).

scheme: Hallmarking Scheme (IS 1417 for Gold, IS 2112 for Silver)
labCapabilities: BIS Recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centres nationwide (over 1,400+ AHCs)

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
qcoOrder: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) Order by MeitY
enforcingMinistry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
scope: Applicable to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including microprocessors, laptops, servers, power adapters, and electronic data processing equipment.
testingRequirements: Electric strength and insulation test (Hipot test)
Touch current and protective conductor current measurement
Temperature rise test under normal and fault conditions
Mechanical strength and drop test
Flammability test of plastic enclosures (V-0, V-1 grades)

clauses.title: Components Safety
clauses.text: Critical safety components such as power supplies, optocouplers, transformers, and fuses must independently comply with relevant Indian Standards or IEC standards.

clauses.title: Protection from Electric Shock
clauses.text: Equipment shall be so constructed that live parts are not accessible to test finger probes during operation.

scheme: Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS / R-Number)

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor, for Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V
qcoOrder: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices (Quality Control) Order, 2023
enforcingMinistry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
scope: Covers single-core and multi-core PVC insulated electrical cables used for domestic wiring, industrial power supply, lighting, and electrical appliances up to 1100 Volts.
testingRequirements: Conductor resistance test (ohms/km at 20°C)
High voltage insulation test (3 kV AC for 5 minutes)
Insulation resistance test at 20°C and 70°C
Tensile strength and elongation test of PVC insulation
Flame retardancy / Flammability test (IEC 60332-1)
Thermal stability test

clauses.title: Conductors
clauses.text: Conductors shall consist of annealed high conductivity copper (plain or tinned) or aluminum as specified in IS 8130.

clauses.title: Marking Requirements
clauses.text: The cable shall be embossed or printed with Manufacturer's Name, IS 694, Voltage Grade, and ISI Mark every 1 metre along the sheath.

scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark Certification Scheme

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
scope: Applies to safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes, such as electric irons, water heaters, room heaters, mixers, food processors, and microwave ovens.
testingRequirements: Protection against access to live parts
Power input and current verification
Heating test and thermal limit switch verification
Leakage current and electric strength at operating temperature
Abnormal operation and locked-rotor testing
Moisture resistance and IP protection rating

clauses.title: Protection Against Shock
clauses.text: Appliance shall be constructed so that its enclosure provides adequate protection against accidental contact with live parts.

clauses.title: Abnormal Operation
clauses.text: Appliance must not emit flames, molten metal, or poisonous gas when operated under simulated failure conditions like blocked thermostat.

scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark Certification Scheme

title: Mobile Phone Handsets - Indian Language Support for Mobile Phone Handsets - Specific Requirements
qcoOrder: Mandatory Mobile Phone Language Support Order by MeitY
scope: Specifies mandatory requirements for message typing, display of text, and keyboard entry for 22 official Indian languages on all mobile handsets sold in India.
testingRequirements: Font rendering verification for Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, Kannada, Malayalam, etc.
Input text keyboard layout and character entry test
Emergency SOS button triggering test (triple press 112 / long press 5)

clauses.title: Language Display Capability
clauses.text: Mobile handsets must display incoming and outgoing SMS and system menus in all 22 official scheduled Indian languages.

clauses.title: Text Input Capability
clauses.text: Handsets with physical or virtual keyboards must support input in Hindi, English, and at least one regional language based on region.

scheme: Scheme II - CRS Compulsory Registration Scheme

title: Safety of Toys - Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
enforcingMinistry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
scope: Applies to all toys intended for use by children under 14 years of age. Covers physical hazards like sharp edges, small parts choke hazards, heavy metal migration, and phthalates.
testingRequirements: Drop test, impact test, and torque test for small part detachment
Sharp edge and sharp point inspection
Heavy element migration testing (Antimony, Arsenic, Barium, Cadmium, Chromium, Lead, Mercury, Selenium)
Phthalate content testing (DBP, BBP, DEHP, DINP, DNOP, DIDP max 0.1%)

clauses.title: Small Parts Hazard
clauses.text: Toys intended for children under 36 months must not fit entirely into small parts test cylinder to prevent choking.

clauses.title: Accessible Edges
clauses.text: Accessible glass or metal edges on toys shall not present an unreasonable risk of cut injury during normal use.

scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark (Type Testing + Factory Inspection)

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
qcoOrder: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
scope: Covers requirements for structural steel sections, plates, flats, beams, channels, and angles used in bridges, transmission towers, buildings, and general engineering.
testingRequirements: Tensile strength and Yield strength
Charpy V-notch Impact test at 0°C / -20°C
Chemical analysis (Carbon, Manganese, Silicon, Sulphur, Phosphorus, CE value)
Dimensional tolerance and flatness check

clauses.title: Chemical Composition
clauses.text: Carbon equivalent (CE) based on ladle analysis shall not exceed 0.42% for grade E250.

clauses.title: Charpy Impact Test
clauses.text: Impact energy for sub-zero quality grades shall meet minimum 27 Joules at specified temperature.

scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark Certification Scheme
